fusions.name: Link to Link
fusions.desc: Lashes the first enemy in line with a blow that deals 4 damage, and the force carries on to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 70% of that each.

fusions.name: Whole Length Swung
fusions.desc: Swings the full length in a circle. It deals 28 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles, ignoring their armour, with a 50% chance to leave each [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Hauled In
fusions.desc: Anchors a 5-tile length ahead of you for 6 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward and slows those it catches by 25% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Barbed Flail
fusions.desc: Conjures a weighted flail of barbed links. Your weapon damage rises by 12% and you attack 5% faster, and every strike with it makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.
